s.note: the Portobello Road market outside William's shop
s.how: Split a loaf of crusty bread and fill with sliced brie, ham and a spread of tomato chutney. Cut into small pieces and pin with toothpicks. Serve on a board with a bowl of green olives, like lunch from a market stall.

Butter thick white bread on the outside. Fill with sliced cheddar, tomato and a spoon of pickle relish. Toast in a pan over medium heat until golden and melting, pressing down. Cut into quarters. Simple enough even for a flatmate.

m.note: Honey's birthday dinner at Max and Bella's
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then add 250g mushrooms and cook until golden. Pour in 250ml white wine and simmer 20 minutes, then stir in 200ml cream and chopped tarragon. Serve with mashed potato and green beans at a small birthday dinner.

w.note: the last brownie at Honey's birthday dinner
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk in 250g sugar and 3 eggs, then fold in 100g flour and 2 tbsp cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes. Cut into squares and keep the very last one aside for whoever tells the saddest story.

d.note: William spilling orange juice all over Anna
d.how: Squeeze 8 oranges and strain into a jug. Pour over ice in short glasses. Carry them carefully and look where you are going, because orange juice is best kept in the glass and not on a famous film star.
